items.source: This interface should be used to export application resources to JMX using Spring's management interface generation capabilities and, optionally, it's ObjectName generation capabilities.
items.translation: 此接口应使用 Spring 的管理接口生成功能将应用程序资源导出到 JMX，并且可选地，使用其 ObjectName 生成功能。

items.source: Register the supplied resource with JMX.
items.translation: 将提供的资源注册到 JMX。

items.source: Remove the specified MBean from the underlying MBeanServer registry.
items.translation: 从底层 MBeanServer 注册表中删除指定的 MBean。

items.source: managedResource - the resource to expose via JMX
items.translation: managedResource - 要通过 JMX 暴露的资源

items.source: Register the supplied resource with JMX. If the resource is not a valid MBean already, Spring will generate a management interface for it. The exact interface generated will depend on the implementation and its configuration. This call also generates an ObjectName for the managed resource and returns this to the caller.
items.translation: 将提供的资源注册到 JMX。如果该资源本身不是有效的 MBean，Spring 将为它生成一个管理接口。生成的确切接口取决于实现及其配置。此调用还会为受管资源生成一个 ObjectName，并将其返回给调用者。

items.source:
Register the supplied resource with JMX. If the resource is not a valid MBean already,
Spring will generate a management interface for it. The exact interface generated will
depend on the implementation and its configuration.
items.translation: 将提供的资源注册到 JMX。如果该资源本身不是有效的 MBean，Spring 将为它生成一个管理接口。生成的具体接口取决于实现及其配置。

items.source: MBeanExportException - if Spring is unable to generate an ObjectName or register the MBean
items.translation: MBeanExportException - 如果 Spring 无法生成 ObjectName 或注册 MBean

items.source: objectName - the ObjectName under which to expose the resource
items.translation: objectName - 在此资源下暴露资源的 ObjectName

items.source: objectName - the ObjectName of the resource to remove
items.translation: objectName - 要删除的资源的 ObjectName

items.source: the ObjectName under which the resource was exposed
items.translation: 资源暴露所在的 ObjectName

items.source: MBeanExportException - if Spring is unable to register the MBean
items.translation: MBeanExportException - 如果 Spring 无法注册 MBean
